g.text: V10: capacity scaling of parameter memory and typed composition

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Frozen protocol: 32, 64 and 128 addresses per type; 3 optimization seeds on one authored task.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Lines: pooled counts across seeds. Small points: individual seeds (slightly offset for visibility). No confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Panel C uses held-out queries with hold=false; hold-triggered denials are excluded from its denominator.
